headline: SKIL Infrastructure Limited: Ninth Committee of Creditors Meeting Outcome
sum: SKIL Infrastructure Limited held its ninth Committee of Creditors meeting under the Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process (CIRP). The outcome and resolutions from this meeting were communicated to the NSE.
implication: Serial CoC meetings over an extended CIRP timeline suggest protracted resolution negotiations, highlighting the complexity of large infrastructure insolvencies and potential creditor-stakeholder alignment challenges under the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code.
detail: SKIL Infrastructure Limited, an infrastructure company, is in active Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process under the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016. The ninth meeting of its Committee of Creditors was convened on 12 August 2026. The company formally intimated the National Stock Exchange of India Limited about the outcome of this meeting, as mandated under listing regulations and IBC disclosure norms. The progression to a ninth CoC meeting indicates extended resolution negotiations and a complex creditor structure.
